main.description: A bounding box representing a rectangular geographic area defined by its corner coordinates.

north.description: The northern latitude boundary of the bounding box, as a WGS84 decimal degrees string.

west.description: The western longitude boundary of the bounding box, as a WGS84 decimal degrees string. West of the prime meridian is negative.

south.description: The southern latitude boundary of the bounding box, as a WGS84 decimal degrees string. South of the equator is negative.

east.description: The eastern longitude boundary of the bounding box, as a WGS84 decimal degrees string.

name.description: The name of the bounding box, if any.
